body:
## Expected Behavior
Workers should report correct WORKER_TASK_SLOTS_AVAILABLE when PollerBehaviorAutoscaling is enabled.

## Actual Behavior
Workers report 0 WORKER_TASK_SLOTS_AVAILABLE when PollerBehaviorAutoscaling is enabled.

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem
  1. Enabled PollerBehaviorAutoscaling on a worker
  2. Run workflows on the worker
  3. Observe WORKER_TASK_SLOTS_AVAILABLE stays at 0

## Specifications

  - Version: latest
  - Platform:
title: WORKER_TASK_SLOTS_AVAILABLE stuck at zero when PollerBehaviorAutoscaling enabled
